eng112-01.stem: The bus driver often complains about chewing gum found under passenger seats because it is ＿＿＿＿ and very hard to remove.
eng112-01.ex:
句意：公車司機常抱怨座位底下的口香糖，因為它很＿＿＿又很難清掉。

(A) sticky 黏的 ✓

(B) greasy 油膩的 (C) clumsy 笨拙的 (D) mighty 強大的。
eng112-01.k: sticky＝黏黏的，所以 very hard to remove（很難清除）。

eng112-02.stem: Jesse is a talented model. He can easily adopt an elegant ＿＿＿＿ for a camera shoot.
eng112-02.ex:
句意：Jesse 是很有天分的模特兒，拍照時能輕鬆擺出優雅的＿＿＿。

(C) pose 姿勢 ✓

(A) clap 拍手 (B) toss 拋擲 (D) snap 啪的一聲、快照。

eng112-03.stem: In order to draw her family tree, Mary tried to trace her ＿＿＿＿ back to their arrival in North America.
eng112-03.ex:
句意：為了畫家譜，Mary 試著把她的＿＿＿追溯到他們抵達北美洲的時候。

family tree（家譜）→ (C) ancestors 祖先 ✓

(A) siblings 兄弟姊妹 (B) commuters 通勤者 (D) instructors 講師。
eng112-03.k: trace one's ancestors back to…＝追溯祖先到…。

eng112-04.stem: Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—only to find the shelves almost ＿＿＿＿ and the stock nearly gone.
eng112-04.ex:
句意：一聽到超級颱風警報，Nancy 衝到超市，卻發現貨架幾乎＿＿＿。

bare 空的、光禿禿的 → (B) ✓

(A) blank 空白的（紙、表格）、(C) hollow 中空的（樹幹、牆），都不是「東西被買光」的意思（各約 30% 誤選）。

(D) queer 奇怪的。
eng112-04.k: bare shelves＝貨架空空的（被搶購一空）。

eng112-05.stem: Even though Jack said “Sorry!” to me in person, I did not feel any ＿＿＿＿ in his apology.
eng112-05.ex:
句意：雖然 Jack 當面對我說了「對不起」，我在他的道歉中感受不到任何＿＿＿。

(D) sincerity 真誠 ✓

(B) generosity 慷慨（24% 誤選）(A) liability 責任、負債 (C) integrity 正直。

eng113-01.stem: People who desire a ＿＿＿＿ figure should exercise regularly and maintain healthy eating habits.
eng113-01.ex:
句意：想要＿＿＿身材的人應規律運動、維持健康飲食。

(B) slender 苗條的 ✓（正面意涵，常搭 figure）。

(C) slight 常指「輕微的」，形容身材時偏向瘦小單薄，不是一般追求的體態（全國 29% 誤選）。

(A) spicy 辣的 (D) slippery 滑的。

eng113-02.stem: Watching the sun ＿＿＿＿ from a sea of clouds is a must-do activity for all visitors to Ali Mountain.
eng113-02.ex:
句意：看太陽從雲海中＿＿＿，是阿里山遊客必做的活動。

(A) emerging 浮現、出現 ✓

(D) floating 漂浮（全國 18% 誤選）(B) flashing 閃爍 (C) rushing 衝。
eng113-02.k: the sun emerging from a sea of clouds＝太陽從雲海中升起。

eng113-03.stem: Do you know what time the next bus is ＿＿＿＿ ? I’ve been waiting here for more than 30 minutes.
eng113-03.ex:
句意：你知道下一班公車幾點＿＿＿嗎？我已經等超過 30 分鐘了。

What time is the next bus due? → (B) due 預定到達的 ✓

(C) bound 要用 be bound for＋地點「開往…」，不能單獨接時間（全國 24% 誤選）。

(A) apt 易於…的 (D) docked 停泊（船）。四個選項選擇率都在 25% 左右，due 這個用法很多人不熟。

eng113-04.stem: The roasting heat and high ＿＿＿＿ made me feel hot and sticky, no matter what I did to cool off.
eng113-04.ex:
句意：炙熱的天氣加上高＿＿＿，不管怎麼消暑都覺得又熱又黏。

(B) humidity 濕度 ✓

(D) atmosphere 大氣、氣氛（全國 21% 誤選）(A) density 密度 (C) circulation 循環。
eng113-04.k: high humidity＝濕度高，才會 hot and sticky（又熱又黏）。

eng113-05.stem: Artwork created by truly great artists such as Picasso and Monet will no doubt ＿＿＿＿ the test of time.
eng113-05.ex:
句意：畢卡索、莫內等偉大藝術家的作品，無疑能＿＿＿時間的考驗。

(D) stand ✓——stand the test of time 是固定片語。

(B) take a test 是「參加考試」，不是「經得起考驗」（全國 25% 誤選）。
eng113-05.k: stand the test of time＝經得起時間的考驗（固定片語）。

eng113-06.stem: In some countries, military service is ＿＿＿＿ for men only; women do not have to serve in the military.
eng113-06.ex:
句意：在某些國家，只有男性必須＿＿＿服兵役；女性不用。

「必須服役」→ (C) compulsory 義務的、強制的 ✓

(D) distinctive 獨特的（29% 誤選）(A) forceful 強而有力的（26% 誤選）(B) realistic 實際的。
eng113-06.k: compulsory＝強制的、義務的；後句 women do not have to serve 是對照。

eng113-07.stem: The team complained that its leader always took the ＿＿＿＿ for all the hard work done by the team members.
eng113-07.ex:
句意：團隊抱怨領導者總是把成員辛苦完成的工作＿＿＿。

take the credit for sth＝居功 → (D) credit ✓

(A) take advantage of 是「利用」，後面要接 of，不接 for（全國 39% 誤選）。

(B) revenge 報復 (C) remedy 補救。
eng113-07.k: take the credit for＝把功勞攬在自己身上。

eng113-08.stem: Located at the center of the city, the business hotel ＿＿＿＿ not only good service but also convenient public transport.
eng113-08.ex:
句意：這家商務旅館位於市中心，＿＿＿不只有好服務，還有便利的大眾運輸。

(C) promises 保證提供 ✓——描述旅館「能帶給客人什麼」。

(B) contains 包含，指容器或物體內含某物，不能說旅館 contains 交通便利（全國 58% 誤選，是本週最容易錯的陷阱）。

(A) proposes 提議 (D) confirms 確認。
eng113-08.k: promise＝保證會有（某種好處）；contain 是「實體裡面裝著」。

eng113-09.stem: As blood supplies have fallen to a critically low level, many hospitals are making an ＿＿＿＿ for the public to donate blood.
eng113-09.ex:
句意：血庫存量降到危險的低點，許多醫院正＿＿＿民眾捐血。

make an appeal for sb to do sth → (A) appeal 呼籲 ✓

(C) operation 手術（26% 誤選）(B) approach 方法 (D) observation 觀察。
eng113-09.k: make an appeal for the public to…＝呼籲大眾去做…。

eng113-10.stem: David felt disappointed when he found out that he could not choose his study partners, but would be ＿＿＿＿ placed in a study group.
eng113-10.ex:
句意：David 發現不能自己選讀書夥伴，而是會被＿＿＿分組，覺得很失望。

不能自己選 → (B) randomly 隨機地 ✓

(A) eligibly 合格地 (C) apparently 顯然 (D) consequently 因此。

eng114-01.stem: If you put a ＿＿＿＿ under a leaking faucet, you will be surprised at the amount of water collected in 24 hours.
eng114-01.ex:
句意：如果你在漏水的水龍頭下放一個＿＿＿，你會很驚訝 24 小時能接到多少水。

要「接水」→ (C) container 容器 ✓

(A) border 邊界 (B) timer 計時器 (D) marker 麥克筆、標記。
eng114-01.k: put a container under a leaking faucet＝在漏水的水龍頭下放容器接水。

eng114-02.stem: The local farmers’ market is popular as it offers a variety of fresh seasonal ＿＿＿＿ to people in the community.
eng114-02.ex:
句意：當地的農夫市集很受歡迎，因為它提供社區民眾各種新鮮的當季＿＿＿。

(A) produce 農產品 ✓——fresh seasonal produce 新鮮當季農產品。

produce 當名詞時重音在第一音節（PRO-duce），當動詞時在第二音節。

(B) fashion 時尚 (C) brand 品牌 (D) trend 趨勢。

eng114-03.stem: As the years have passed by, many of my childhood memories are already ＿＿＿＿ ; I can no longer recall clearly what happened back then.
eng114-03.ex:
句意：隨著歲月流逝，我許多童年記憶已經＿＿＿；我再也記不清楚…。

後句「記不清楚」→ (A) blurring 變模糊 ✓

(C) draining 流失、耗盡（全國 24% 誤選），多用於金錢、體力，不用來形容記憶模糊。

(B) trimming 修剪 (D) glaring 刺眼的。
eng114-03.k: memories are blurring＝記憶變得模糊。

eng114-04.stem: Racist remarks are by nature ＿＿＿＿ and hurtful, and should be avoided on all occasions.
eng114-04.ex:
句意：種族歧視的言論本質上就是＿＿＿又傷人的，任何場合都應避免。

(C) offensive 冒犯的 ✓

(B) furious 狂怒的（形容人的情緒，全國 23% 誤選）(A) excessive 過度的 (D) stubborn 固執的。
eng114-04.k: offensive＝冒犯的、令人不舒服的；與 hurtful（傷人的）並列。

eng114-05.stem: Not satisfied with the first ＿＿＿＿ of her essay, Mary revised it several times before turning it in to the teacher.
eng114-05.ex:
句意：Mary 對作文的第一份＿＿＿不滿意，交給老師前改了好幾次。

(C) draft 草稿 ✓

(A) text 文本、簡訊 (B) brush 刷子 (D) plot 情節（全國 20% 誤選）。
eng114-05.k: first draft＝初稿；revised it several times＝改了好幾次。

eng114-06.stem: Left ＿＿＿＿ for years, the deserted house was filled with a thick coating of dust and a smell of old damp wood.
eng114-06.ex:
句意：這棟廢棄的房子＿＿＿多年，積了厚厚的灰塵，還有舊濕木頭的味道。

(D) vacant 空置的 ✓——left vacant for years。

(C) remote 偏遠的（全國 20% 誤選），與「積灰塵」沒有直接因果。

(A) casual 隨意的 (B) fragile 易碎的。
eng114-06.k: left vacant＝閒置、空著；deserted house＝廢棄的房子。

eng114-07.stem: The high school student showed ＿＿＿＿ courage when she helped the old man escape from the fire.
eng114-07.ex:
句意：那名高中生幫老人逃離火場時，展現了＿＿＿的勇氣。

(D) enormous 極大的 ✓——可形容抽象名詞（enormous courage/pressure）。

(A) gigantic 巨大的，多用於體積、形體（全國 21% 誤選）。

(B) exclusive 獨家的 (C) multiple 多重的。
eng114-07.k: enormous courage＝極大的勇氣；gigantic 多形容實體的「巨大」。

eng114-08.stem: Publicly financed projects are often ＿＿＿＿ or delayed during tough economic times due to a lack of resources.
eng114-08.ex:
句意：經濟不景氣時，公家出資的工程常因資源不足而被＿＿＿或延後。

與 delayed 並列、原因是缺乏資源 → (A) halted 停止 ✓

(B) hatched 孵化、策劃（全國 21% 誤選）(C) possessed 擁有 (D) reinforced 加強。

eng114-09.stem: Despite his busy schedule, the President ＿＿＿＿ the school’s graduation ceremony with his presence and a heartwarming speech.
eng114-09.ex:
句意：儘管行程忙碌，總統仍＿＿＿學校的畢業典禮，並發表暖心演說。

grace A with one's presence 是固定用法：「以某人的出席為 A 增光」→ (B) graced ✓

(C) addressed 可以指「對…演說」，但不能接 with his presence（全國 43% 誤選）。

(A) praised 稱讚 (D) credited 歸功於。
eng114-09.k: grace … with one's presence＝蒞臨增光。

eng114-10.stem: The manager of the company was sued for ＿＿＿＿ abusing his colleagues, calling them “hopeless losers.”
eng114-10.ex:
句意：這位經理因為＿＿＿辱罵同事、罵他們「無可救藥的魯蛇」而被告。

罵人是用說的 → (A) verbally 言語上地 ✓

(B) dominantly 占優勢地 (C) legitimately 合法地 (D) relevantly 相關地。
eng114-10.k: verbally abuse＝言語辱罵（calling them "hopeless losers"）。

eng115-01.stem: The mayor has such a ＿＿＿＿ schedule that it takes weeks to arrange an interview with her.
eng115-01.ex:
句意：市長的行程非常＿＿＿，要安排一次訪談得等好幾週。

(B) tight 緊湊的 ✓——tight schedule 是固定搭配。

(A) hasty 倉促的（形容動作或決定）(C) diligent 勤勉的（形容人）(D) routine 例行的，都無法說明「要等好幾週」。

eng115-02.stem: Jane started as an ＿＿＿＿ art designer, but now she has a professional studio of her own.
eng115-02.ex:
句意：Jane 一開始是＿＿＿的美術設計師，但現在已經有自己的專業工作室。

but 前後對比：一開始「業餘」→ 現在「專業」→ (C) amateur ✓

(D) elementary 是「初級的、基本的」（elementary school），不是「業餘」，全國 23% 誤選。

(A) official 官方的 (B) instant 立即的。
eng115-02.k: amateur 業餘的 ↔ professional 專業的，句中用 but 形成對比。

eng115-03.stem: The teaching ＿＿＿＿ at the famous high school soon attracted more than a dozen well-qualified applicants.
eng115-03.ex:
句意：這所名校的教職＿＿＿很快吸引了十多位條件優秀的應徵者。

有「應徵者」→ 需要的是「職缺」→ (B) vacancy ✓

(A) career 職業生涯 (C) expectation 期待 (D) inspiration 靈感。
eng115-03.k: teaching vacancy＝教職缺額，才會吸引應徵者（applicants）。

eng115-04.stem: Designed by a young engineer, the new product has created far more profit than ＿＿＿＿ expected.
eng115-04.ex:
句意：這項由年輕工程師設計的新產品，創造的利潤遠超過＿＿＿預期。

(A) initially 起初、原本 ✓——than initially expected 是常見說法。

(B) genuinely 真誠地 (C) alternatively 或者 (D) fundamentally 根本上。
eng115-04.k: than initially expected＝比原本預期的還要多。

eng115-05.stem: It has been confirmed that a balanced ＿＿＿＿ of fruit and vegetables is a key element to good health.
eng115-05.ex:
句意：已證實均衡＿＿＿蔬果是健康的關鍵。

(D) consumption 攝取、食用 ✓

(A) dimension 維度 (B) integration 整合 (C) provision 供應（是「提供」，不是「吃」）。
eng115-05.k: a balanced consumption of fruit and vegetables＝均衡攝取蔬果。

eng115-06.stem: As a shy boy afraid of making public appearances, Timmy ＿＿＿＿ the thought of speaking before large audiences.
eng115-06.ex:
句意：Timmy 是個害羞、怕公開露面的男孩，他＿＿＿在一大群人面前說話的念頭。

前面說他 afraid of making public appearances → (A) dreads 懼怕 ✓

(B) stresses 強調（全國 30% 誤選）(C) wanders 漫遊 (D) escapes 逃脫。

這題 A、B、D 選擇率接近，代表 dread 是很多人不熟的高頻字。

eng115-07.stem: To the newly-crowned winner of the piano competition, music is his life’s ＿＿＿＿ , which he has devoted himself to whole-heartedly.
eng115-07.ex:
句意：對這位剛奪冠的鋼琴家來說，音樂是他一生的＿＿＿，他全心投入其中。

(C) passion 熱情 ✓

(A) resource 資源 (B) impact 影響 (D) emphasis 強調。
eng115-07.k: life's passion＝一生的熱情所在，呼應 devoted himself to（全心投入）。

eng115-08.stem: The drunk driver who shouted at passers-by and ＿＿＿＿ them with glass bottles was quickly arrested by the police.
eng115-08.ex:
句意：那名酒駕司機對路人大吼，還拿玻璃瓶＿＿＿他們，很快就被警察逮捕。

受詞是 them（路人）→ 攻擊人 → (B) assaulted ✓

(A) shattered 打碎（東西），全國 29% 誤選，被「玻璃瓶」誤導。

(C) overturned 翻倒、推翻 (D) condemned 譴責。
eng115-08.k: assault＝攻擊（人）；shatter 是打碎（物品）。

eng115-09.stem: There were so many people at the bus station that I had to ＿＿＿＿ my way through the crowd to board the bus in time.
eng115-09.ex:
句意：公車站人太多，我必須＿＿＿穿過人群，才能及時上車。

「V＋one's way＋through」表示「用某種方式開出一條路」：elbow/push/fight one's way through the crowd。

(C) elbow（用手肘推擠）最能描寫在人群中擠過去 ✓

(D) struggle 著重「奮力掙扎」，常說 struggle through the crowd，放在這個句型不如 elbow 貼切（全國 39% 誤選）。

(A) crash 撞 (B) tumble 跌倒。
eng115-09.k: elbow one's way through＝用手肘在人群中擠出一條路。

eng115-10.stem: Deadly shootings on US campuses have raised ＿＿＿＿ concerns about how to prevent such tragic incidents from happening again.
eng115-10.ex:
句意：美國校園致命的槍擊事件，引發外界對如何防止悲劇再發生的＿＿＿關切。

(D) grave 嚴重的 ✓——raise grave concerns 是新聞常見搭配。

(C) harsh 嚴厲的，常搭 criticism、words、punishment，不說 harsh concerns（全國 38% 誤選）。

(A) swift 迅速的 (B) brutal 殘暴的。
eng115-10.k: grave concerns＝嚴重的關切（固定搭配）。
